I can't say whether the property is legally compliant. The evidence doesn't make any regulatory or compliance finding, including on EUDR or deforestation-free status.

What it does show for ASSET-B (2,843.1 ha):
- No tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected between 2021-01-01 and 2025-12-31. Valid observations covered the whole asset.
- Hansen data show only 0.4 ha of loss in sub-0.5 ha patches in 2021. These are not counted as events.
- JRC data show no forest in 2020 (0 ha, 0%).
- Before the baseline, Hansen records loss events in 2008 (0.8 ha), 2015 (25.5 ha), 2017 (4.8 ha) and 2020 (67.7 ha). These fall outside the claim period.

Limits: changes under 0.5 ha, at edges, or narrower than the 30 m pixels may be missed. The evidence says nothing about periods outside 2021–2025. Legal compliance would need a separate assessment against the applicable rules.
